slice: runs/ (experiment + runtime output trees) and vault/ (knowledge plane, structure only)
summary: runs/ is not one thing: it mixes exactly one properly registered isolated experiment (higher_twin_nc, with SPEC.md, sealed evaluator, receipts, 46 tests), a handful of canonical kernel runtime stores that legitimately live here (budget/ledger.json, spine/spine.sqlite3, progress/events.jsonl, ikarus/conversations.sqlite3, canary/history.jsonl, council/), one unregistered comparative study (ab/), and several gigabyte-scale piles of stale swarm/eval output that are gitignored yet still tracked. The single largest hygiene defect is 2908 tracked-but-ignored files under runs/ (funnel, eval, audit_swarm, audit_swarm_v1_invalid, plan_critique, build): the .gitignore rules were added after the files were committed, so ignoring them has no effect and they stay in history and in every checkout. There is no experiment registry: only higher_twin_nc/SPEC.md satisfies plan section 14's spec/scope/budget/evaluator/expiry requirement, and runs/ab/SPEC.md is a build brief masquerading under the same filename. vault/ is in good shape - a small, disciplined, link-not-copy knowledge plane (Home, Gates, Amendments, Findings/Index, Sessions daily notes, Templates) that explicitly disclaims authority, matching Invariant 7 and plan section 7's product-memory separation.

integration_gaps: No experiment registry exists. Plan section 14 requires every experiment to record spec, scope, budget, evaluator and expiry, but the only place that happens is runs/higher_twin_nc/SPEC.md. runs/ab, runs/funnel/codebase-500 (which has named arms: plan, plan_noindex_control, plan_fileindex_arm2), runs/eval/deepseek_r2|r3 and runs/audit_swarm are all measurement trees with no spec, no budget line and no expiry. Nothing can enumerate 'which experiments are live'.

2908 files under runs/ are tracked despite matching .gitignore (funnel, eval, audit_swarm, audit_swarm_v1_invalid, plan_critique, build). The ignore rules were added after the commits, so they do nothing: `git ls-files -i -c --exclude-standard runs | wc -l` = 2908. Either `git rm --cached` them or drop the rules; the current state is a lie about what the repo tracks.

runs/budget/ledger.json is the spend ledger for Invariant 8 and it is a tracked, mutable, currently-dirty file. Its policy-sibling stores (spine, canary, ikarus, progress) are all gitignored. A budget ledger that changes on every run and lands in commits/merges is exactly the artifact Invariant 3 says candidates must not be able to touch - and here every ordinary commit touches it.

runs/spine/ is gitignored wholesale, which also hides gate_discrimination.json, gate_discrimination.whole_suite.json and operability_drill.json. Those are Gate-0 exit evidence (fail-closed/fail-open fault-injection matrix). Gate 0 cannot be declared closed on evidence nobody outside this machine can read.

The authoritative council transcripts (runs/council/*.jsonl) and their hash-chain anchors (*.jsonl.anchor.json) are gitignored while the derived room.md mirror is tracked. The provenance chain (Invariant 7) is the ignored half.

runs/higher_twin_nc/.gitignore uses `runs/*/work/`, which misses the nested per-arm layout introduced by the descent and squares rounds; 7 work/ trees are currently untracked and unignored. Should be `runs/**/work/`.

runs/higher_twin_nc/tests/ (10 modules, the isolation and sealed-evaluator evidence) is not part of the repo's main test collection, so the experiment's own invariant claims are only checked when run by hand.

runs/plan_critique holds 102 critique files aimed at the master plan and none of them is referenced from docs/IKARUS_ARIADNE_MASTER_PLAN.amendments.jsonl or vault/Amendments/Amendments.md. Critique was produced and never entered the amendment protocol.

vault/Gates/Gate-Status.md and vault/Amendments/Amendments.md are hand-maintained mirrors of machine-readable sources (the plan, the amendments jsonl). Nothing checks the mirror against the source, and vault/Home.md's status table is already 4 days behind the session notes in the same vault.

Two rooms exist (.room/room.md and runs/council/room.md), both tracked, and only the runs/council one is known to daedalus/health.py. The `room` skill writes to the project-root .room/, so the next room session will silently resume the stale 2026-07-29 transcript rather than the current one.
notable: runs/higher_twin_nc is genuinely exemplary and should be the template for every future experiment: pre-registered hypotheses with an explicit adjudication rule, a sealed L0-L4 evaluator, no imports from daedalus/, receipts with verify_analysis and a chained head hash, and session notes that write down their own limits ('n=1 Fixture: Kalibrierung, kein Wirksamkeitsbeweis'). That last sentence is Invariant 9 being honored voluntarily.

The .gitignore has grown three distinct generations of rules that now contradict each other: broad path globs (runs/funnel/**), one accidental bare-name rule (`build/` on line 50, which swallows runs/build/), and a carefully commented council block (lines 53-64). The bare `build/` rule is worth fixing on its own - it silently ignores a directory daedalus/build.py:47 actively writes to.

runs/arch_memory.shown is tracked and modified while runs/arch_memory.json is ignored by `runs/*.json` - a one-character extension difference decides whether architecture-memory state is versioned. Almost certainly unintentional.

runs/drafts contains ~20 byte-identical `summarize-the-notes-file` drafts from 2026-07-06 and 2026-07-11, plus entries whose repo_root points at C:\Users\nukei\Desktop\project_tct. The Daedalus runs/ tree is carrying another project's history.
runs/gui/report.json records contrast_failures: 228 on the live app at 1440x900. Nothing tracks or gates that number, and 4 MB of PNG evidence for it sits in git.

runs/audit_swarm_v1_invalid is correctly retained as negative evidence per AGENTS.md, but there is no note anywhere saying why v1 was invalid. Retained failures without the finding are storage, not evidence.
runs/eval/deepseek_lab/wrecked/ is the only other retained-failure tree and it is equally unexplained.

The gitignore comment at lines 53-55 ('The TOOLING under runs/council/ is source and is committed; everything below is produced by running it') is the only place in the repo that states the source-vs-output rule for runs/. If that principle were applied uniformly across runs/, most of the debris in this slice would resolve itself - runs/ is currently three things (experiment source, kernel runtime state, disposable swarm output) sharing one namespace with no naming convention to tell them apart.
vault/Sessions/2026-08-18.md is untracked while 2026-08-17, -20 and -21 are committed - the append-only session chain has a local-only gap on exactly the day the Gate-0 matrix was signed.
